pages.title: Illager Honor
pages.text: Drink a $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Savage Essence$() to gain Illager Honor. This permanent alliance effect makes Illagers friendly toward you.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: Illager Honor provides 10 recruitment slots by default. You lose it if you kill an Illager-side creature.$(br2)Bad Omen temporarily suppresses the effect. Illager Honor returns when Bad Omen ends.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: While any Raidborn alliance effect is active, Villager interaction is blocked, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village cannot be gained.
